name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Shows progress through a multi-step flow or checklist, with done, current, waiting and failed steps.

when: A flow of three or more steps: checkout, signup, setup.

builtIn: The current step has aria-current; the list is named with the overall progress.

genui.description: Steps of a flow. steps are {id, label, description?}; currentStep is the id of the step in progress.

steps.description: Three to six steps, in order.

currentStep.description: The step the reader is on: `aria-current="step"`. Ignored with `isComplete`.

orientation.description: `horizontal` for a flow on one page (checkout, signup); `vertical` for checklists (onboarding, setup).

Stepper.name: steps
Stepper.description: Three to six steps, in order.

Stepper.name: currentStep
Stepper.description: The step the reader is on: `aria-current="step"`. Ignored with `isComplete`.

Stepper.name: completedSteps
Stepper.description: Done steps; by default every step before the current one. Ignored with `isComplete`.

Stepper.name: isComplete
Stepper.description:
The flow is finished: every step shows its done state and none is current, so no step
carries `aria-current`. The list is named with the overall state ("Progress, All steps done"),
and the narrow one-line form reads "All steps done" over a full bar. A `stepStatus` or
`statusText` entry still speaks for its step, in the list and, under the done line, in the narrow form
too ("Domain · With us"). A finished flow cannot also have a `failed` or `needs-you` step: that
pairing contradicts itself and warns in development; settle the step first. Left out, nothing changes.

Stepper.name: onStepPress
Stepper.description: Makes done steps pressable (back to an earlier step). Leave it out where the flow cannot go back.

Stepper.name: orientation
Stepper.description: `horizontal` for a flow on one page (checkout, signup); `vertical` for checklists (onboarding, setup).

Stepper.name: stepStatus
Stepper.description:
A journey across pages (signup → payment → setup): per-step status words. With it, done and current
steps say so in words too.

Stepper.name: statusText
Stepper.description: Replaces a step's status words ("With us · 1–2 business days").
